verdict.rationale: Docs show OCR output can carry confidence scores at page, block, or word granularity via the confidence_scores_granularity parameter. That gives a data engineer a raw signal to route low-confidence content. However, nothing shows the scores are calibrated, that they attach to structured annotation fields, or that the product provides any review path. A community user mentions doing human review of a small fraction of forms, but as their own process, not a product feature. Missing for 10: evidence of score calibration, per-field confidence on document_annotation structured outputs, a built-in human-in-the-loop review workflow or queue for low-confidence fields, independent hands-on corroboration of confidence-score usefulness.
